organization-summary.example: The summary of the organization of the signed-in member, read-only, built with the cards module: its name, status and creation, a strip with its active members, groups and additional roles, with the members by status for whoever may see the users; its administrators; every group folded with its count, unfolding its active members in place, and those in no group last; and every additional role, opening its permissions for whoever may already see them, in the sections, icons and order of the roles demo. The demo answers with a fixed organization.
